non-participation in the patient satisfaction survey was independently linked to the presence of a number of barriers to participation.

we need to be careful in the interpretation of the results of patient satisfaction surveys, as some subgroups of the population may not be adequately represented.

the use of a patient satisfaction survey may lead to an overrepresentation of some patient sub-groups and to an under-represention of other sub-groups.
